summary: Publish the Vercel log id fix (#529, DEV-14223): @respan/ai-sdk-provider links the AI SDK model-call span to the gateway log (respan.gateway.log_id from x-respan-log-id) and @respan/instrumentation-vercel drops usage, cost and content from a linked span, so each gateway call shows once in a trace; respan-instrumentation-openai-agents sends the framework session on every span of the run, not only the root. respan-instrumentation-agno is held: it has no PyPI Trusted Publisher for publish.yml (DEV-13958), so it ships in a separate intent once one exists.
